benchmark.desc: Depending on hardware performance and installed mod count, 3DMigoto F10 reload duration varies greatly (typically from 1.1s to 18s).
benchmark.step1: Make sure your game is running in playable state;
benchmark.step2: Click 'Start Benchmark' below. ModDeck will send F10 to game and start millisecond timer;
benchmark.step3: Watch your game: once stutter stops and gameplay resumes smoothly, click 'Stop Timer';
benchmark.step4: ModDeck will automatically calculate best buffer delay based on 'measured time + 1.5s margin'.
benchmark.runningHint: 👀 Please observe your game: once gameplay becomes smooth again, click the button below!
benchmark.recommendHint: (Measured {elapsed}s + 1.5s margin, ensuring shaders finish compiling and cross Present frame)

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: General behavior, game paths, environment checks, and import options. All changes saved locally.

general.overlayDesc: Toggle mods and switch presets anytime in-game using the floating overlay. Click input and press shortcut to save.
general.overlayHotkeyDesc: Current: {hotkey} · Press Esc to hide overlay
general.overlayHotkeyPlaceholder: Click and press key combo, e.g. Alt+Shift+M
general.allowHotkeySend: Allow clicking hotkeys to send to game
general.allowHotkeySendDesc: When clicking mod hotkey capsules in overlay, automatically send physical key events to foreground game window.
general.recentModCount: Recent Mods Display Count in Quick Overlay
general.recentModCountDesc: Number of recently used mod capsules displayed at top of in-game overlay (set to 0 to completely hide recent bar).
general.languageDesc: Choose interface language. Supports Simplified Chinese, English, and external locales/ packages.
general.behaviorDesc: Control 3DMigoto reload hotkey, preset auto-reload policy, and auto-save interval.
general.reloadHotkeyDesc: Default F10. Click input box and press key to change
general.autoReloadModToggle: Auto reload after toggling regular mods
general.autoReloadModToggleDesc: Default off. Avoids frequent game stutter when organizing or batch toggling mods in library.
general.autoReloadModPreset: Auto reload after switching single mod presets
general.autoReloadModPresetDesc: Automatically reloads game when clicking a preset capsule in main view or overlay for instant outfit change.
general.autoReloadRosterPreset: Auto reload after switching full roster schemes
general.autoReloadRosterPresetDesc: Automatically reloads game when switching full roster schemes for instant team outfit change.
general.manualReloadAlertText1: You have disabled auto reload for some presets. Stylistic variables are pre-written to bridge, but in-game screen still requires a reload to display.
general.manualReloadAlertText2: • Recommended way to apply: Press hotkey in-game to bring up overlay, then click 'Reload F10 / Apply Now' button at bottom (displays pulsing '● Apply Now (N)' when presets are pending).
general.manualReloadAlertText3: • Physical F10 Explanation: Pressing physical F10 directly will change outfits in game immediately, but ModDeck UI state won't guess physical keypress due to Windows process isolation. Use overlay button for full UI synchronization.
general.autoSaveIntervalOpt10: 10s (Fastest sync, recommended when using in-game hotkeys)
general.autoSaveIntervalOptDisabled: -1 (Disable timed save, saves on exit or F10)
general.autoSaveIntervalDesc: 💡 Controls how often 3DMigoto automatically flushes in-memory variables to d3dx_user.ini. Writes directly to d3dx.ini. Requires F10 reload while game is running.
general.reloadBufferDelayDesc: 💡 Internal async waiting timer in ModDeck. Pure memory hot-reload without needing F10 or restart. Waiting duration for game shaders to compile and cross Present frame. Click 'Benchmark' to measure.
general.closeBehaviorDesc: When minimized, ModDeck stays in system tray with hotkeys and quick overlay active.

games.title: Game & Directory Paths
games.desc: Only Mods directory is required. Game executable and loader are used for Launch buttons at the top.

environment.desc: Currently EFMI environment check is active. Configuration slots for other loaders are reserved for future updates.
environment.checkStartup: Check DISABLED rule on startup (Default ON)
environment.checkStartupDesc: Automatically verifies if d3dx.ini contains exclude_recursive = DISABLED* rule.

import.title: Mod Import Behavior
import.desc: Supports batch selection or dragging .zip / .7z / .rar archives and extracted folders. Copies by default without deleting source.
import.overwriteDesc: Old directory will be safely backed up to backups folder first; if disabled, auto-renames with incrementing suffix.
import.rosterDesc: Complete built-in offline character dictionary (Chinese, English, Pinyin, aliases). Syncing fetches remote roster.json and merges without losing built-ins.
import.rosterUrlDesc: GitHub Raw or custom mirror URL

about.title: About ModDeck
about.storageDesc: Settings, character metadata, covers, snapshots and logs are kept strictly on this PC. Pure local-first with zero cloud leaks.
about.storageTip: 💡 Contains ModDeck settings, character match data, preset snapshots, and runtime logs. Backup this folder directly when migrating or reinstalling Windows.

advanced.desc: Configure in-game Quick Overlay, 3DMigoto reload hotkeys, auto-switch strategies, and sync timing.
